text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I went fishing yesterday... and had 
a huge haul... I even set a new personal 
record for sea bass size...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she enjoyed a wonderful day off. 
Cheval Grand appeared to be in good 
spirits, even if in her own modest way.
